fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders locate the property quickly from the street.
• Mark or clearly label any secondary access points so arriving responders can quickly identify all available entry options.
• Keep at least one access point to the rear of the property unlocked and clear of parked vehicles at all times.
• Trim dense vegetation along walkways and access paths so responders can move between the main residence and detached structure without obstruction.
• Keep the vehicle parking area clear of stored items so arriving apparatus and personnel have room to stage and work.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the detached structure so responders can reach and work around all sides of the building.
• Post a visible marker or sign at the point where rear access begins to help responders identify the route without having to search for it.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches from large trees that hang directly over or touch the house.
• Thin the tree clusters closest to the structure to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs and low-growing plants that are directly against the exterior walls of the house.
• Separate shrubs and small plants from the base of any outbuildings or detached structures on the property.
• Trim overhanging branches along the driveway so vehicles, including emergency trucks, can pass through without obstruction.
• Cut back vegetation growing along the edges of the driveway to keep the travel lane fully open.
• Thin scattered trees that connect the surrounding vegetation to the area immediately around the house.
• Remove dead branches, dead shrubs, and dry plant material from the ground beneath large trees near the structure.
• Keep the ground beneath trees near the house clear of leaves, needles, and debris that collect and dry out.
• Create visible open breaks between tree groupings surrounding the house so no single line of vegetation runs uninterrupted to the structure.
• Keep the single access route clear of fallen branches, overgrown brush, and any debris that could slow or block a vehicle.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is easy to identify quickly from the road.
• Thin mixed shrubs and trees on the sides of the house where vegetation is densest and closest to the walls.
